analyst_view.overall: Early view: Omonia (18th, 6 points) started with two wins under Henning Berg but have lost their last two, 1-4 to Benfica and 1-3 at NEC. Celtic (32nd, 3 points) got their first league-phase win against Besiktas and lead the Scottish Premiership under Martin O'Neill, but have conceded 11 goals in four European games.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. I lean higher: Celtic's European games have averaged more than four goals and Omonia's more than three, with Omonia conceding seven in their last two. Celtic have 27 goals in 12 Scottish league games and found a spark off the bench through Camilo Duran and Callum Osmand, so both sides should score.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.0 corners, split fairly evenly. Two sides who attack more than they defend fits a high count, and I see no reason to move away from it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards, which looks low. The GSP crowd in Nicosia is noisy, both sides will likely be fighting for a play-off place, and Celtic's defending has been stretched in Europe, which tends to lead to tactical fouls, so I'd expect closer to 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.6 shots. That matches two open sides, so I stay with it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean a little higher: Celtic have conceded 11 goals in four games and Omonia seven in two, which points to plenty of clear chances at both ends.
